- Nov 2023 (25-30): 6 days
- Dec 2023: 31 days
- Jan 2024: 31 days
- Feb 2024: 29 days (leap year)
- Mar 2024: 31 days
- Apr 2024: 30 days
- May 2024 (1-31): 31 days

Total: 6 + 31 + 31 + 29 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 189 days

Answer: 189
